description: Dock team agents only (others are refused). Replaces a LIVE help-center article's title, category, summary and body; the change shows on /help at once. body_markdown allows paragraphs, "## " subheadings, "1. " numbered steps ("1. Title: detail"), "Note: " lines, **bold** and [links](https://... or /help/...); no HTML, images, code or tables. Every edit is kept and audited; revert_help_article undoes the last one.

body_markdown.description: The article body in the restricted markdown subset, up to 20,000 characters.

name: edit_help_article
